baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative binds ءَالَآءِ, رَبِّكُمَا, and تُكَذِّبَانِ to one dual act of response.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal is sourced in a lord whose activity includes nurture and completion, while takdhib actively assigns what was given to falsehood. The dual inflection makes recognition a shared but answerable relation.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the object whose source and reality are being contested.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing formative relation rather than a title alone.
Declaring a thing false turns nonrecognition into an active verdict on the giver's work.

changed_reading.before: A stock rhetorical question about denying blessings.
changed_reading.after: A relational accounting: which acts of completed nurture will the two recipients actively misclassify as unreal?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three focus roots admit oath, covenant, and obligation branches within the question itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath branch of ء ل و and the covenant branch of ر ب ب converge with an idiom of urging under ك ذ ب. Without replacing the ordinary wording, they activate a juridical hearing in which favors also carry pledged claims.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making gives the favors a possible pledged or sworn edge.
A binding pact makes the Lord-recipient relation covenantal and durable.
The idiom of urging or obligation adds the pressure to hold to what the question names.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are asked to admit that favors exist.
changed_reading.after: The addressees are summoned to answer which binding pledges and claims of their Lord they will disown or fail to honor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ءَالَآءِ can activate capacity, رَبِّ can activate growth, and تُكَذِّبَانِ can activate failure of a charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor can be read dynamically as an ability raised in the recipient. Denial then occurs not only in speech but when that cultivated capacity fails to carry through its entrusted task.

activation_trace.role: Capacity supplies a recipient-side form of favor: an ability one can exercise or neglect.
Nurture and growing up recast lordship as raising capacities into maturity.
Fulfilling or failing a charge gives denial a performative success-or-failure axis.

changed_reading.before: Favors are external goods that can be verbally denied.
changed_reading.after: Favors include cultivated abilities whose entrusted use the two addressees can fulfill or betray.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of ءَالَآءِ permits a following sequence and a voice answering a voice inside the dual question.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can function as a responsive turn rather than a self-contained sentence: one disclosure is followed by a voiced challenge that anticipates another voice's answer. This is form-distant but anchored in a supplied non-dominant mapping.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies the temporal relation between disclosure and interrogative response.
A voice following another voice supplies an antiphonal call-and-response mechanism.
The answering voice is forced to take a position by either affirming or declaring false.

changed_reading.before: One isolated rhetorical question speaks at the audience.
changed_reading.after: A following voice opens an answer-slot in which the paired audience must voice its relation to the preceding disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy opens a sequence of teaching and clarification, then the same dual question returns thirty times outside the focus. The following-voice branch therefore changes the refrain from repeated accusation into a severe pedagogical chorus: each disclosure is followed by another exercise in recognition.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and tenderness set the governing pedagogy in which the repeated challenge operates.
Making something disclosed to a knower supplies the teaching-to-recognition process.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign makes the refrain a test of articulated recognition.
The immediately preceding occurrence realizes a voice following the warning sequence.
The next occurrence confirms that another disclosure is again answered by the same responsive voice.
The focus occurrence becomes one link in the ordered chain rather than an isolated saying.

structural_cues: Thirty non-focus occurrences repeat the same dual refrain on both sides of 55:47.
55:1-4 moves from mercy to teaching to human formation to clarification before the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, disclosure, clarification, exact recurrence, and following-voice branches; I infer that recurrence trains response as well as accusing denial. A live alternative is that the refrain only punctuates and intensifies the catalog.

changed_reading.before: The refrain is a repeated accusation whose recurrence adds emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The refrain is an antiphonal recognition drill: mercy keeps returning the paired hearers to the answer they must learn to voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is measured, the balance must be maintained without shortchanging, and good action is answered in kind. Against that arc, the focus branches for falling short and failing a charge make takdhib operational: the addressees deny by giving less than the entrusted response, not only by uttering a false proposition.

activation_trace.role: Proportioning and measuring place created existence inside an ordered charge.
The just balance supplies the norm against which response can succeed or fail.
Equity makes the demanded measure relational rather than merely quantitative.
Shortchanging measure supplies the concrete pattern for an inadequate answer to favor.
Answering an act with its due return completes the charge-and-response circuit.
Good action repeated on both sides specifies the fitting quality of reciprocal response.
Falling short anchors inadequate response in the focus noun's branch field.
Fulfilling or failing a charge converts denial into measurable performance.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 repeats measure language as commands not to exceed or diminish it.
55:60 uses a mirrored action-return construction after the garden sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportion, just measure, shortchanging, charge-failure, and reciprocal action; I infer an arrow from receiving measured nurture to owing a fitting response. The live alternative keeps takdhib entirely propositional.

changed_reading.before: Denying means saying that a favor is false or absent.
changed_reading.after: Denying also means shortchanging the measured charge of favor by failing to return the recognition and good action it calls forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired creaturely audience is challenged to exercise ability, pass beyond the cosmic boundaries, and discover that passage requires a governing warrant. This activates favor as cultivated capacity while making denial the fantasy that capacity is self-grounding or the failure to carry its bounded commission.

activation_trace.role: Ability and power make capacity an explicit test rather than an abstract possession.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the attempted action by which capacity meets its limit.
Compelling warrant or proof makes successful passage dependent rather than autonomous.
Capacity anchors the tested ability back in the focus expression for favors.
Failure of a charge renders misuse of bounded ability as a mode of denial.

structural_cues: 55:33 addresses humans and jinn together before the focus returns to dual morphology.
The permission challenge repeats the passage verb three times and ends by restricting its condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ability, attempted passage, required warrant, and charge-failure; I infer that bestowed agency discloses dependence when it reaches its boundary. A live alternative reads 55:33 only as an impossible escape challenge.

changed_reading.before: The favors are benefits placed before passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: The favors include bounded agency: which cultivated abilities will the two treat as autonomous, or fail to discharge under their Lord's warrant?

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, anticipated harm is attached to standing at the Lord's station and to two tree-concealed gardens; immediately after it, those gardens open into branching multiplicity. The refrain acts as a hinge that asks whether fearful accountability can be recognized as the threshold of cultivated shelter.

activation_trace.role: Fear anticipating harm supplies the affective pressure on the threshold.
Station and standing give accountability a spatially fixed encounter.
A garden sheltered by trees supplies the promised other side of the threshold.
Ramifying branches make the concealed garden unfold into visible plurality.
Favor names the transformation that the hinge asks the hearers to recognize.
Nurture links the feared Lord to the branching shelter without erasing judgment.

structural_cues: 55:47 stands exactly between the promise of two gardens in 55:46 and their first property in 55:48.
The dual addressees, two gardens, and dual garden adjective hold fear and promise in one paired frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anticipated harm, a station, two gardens, and ramifying branches; I infer that the refrain converts the boundary between fear and shelter into a recognition test. A live alternative treats it as a simple comment on the promised gardens.

changed_reading.before: The refrain merely labels the two gardens as another favor.
changed_reading.after: The refrain is the threshold question: can the feared standing itself be recognized as opening, through the Lord's nurture, into branching refuge?

context_deltas.mechanism: The dual audience of the focus is mirrored by two gardens, two springs, paired fruit, and action answered by a corresponding return. Number becomes mechanism: provision is arranged as relation and counterpart, so each member of the addressed pair is asked to recognize a world of fitted correspondences.

activation_trace.role: The tree-sheltered garden appears in a dual form that begins the answering pattern.
Two flowing sources repeat paired provision inside the two gardens.
A counterpart joined to its mate makes pairing an explicit relational structure.
An act met by its corresponding recompense extends pairing from objects to moral response.
The Lord of both anchors every counterpart in one shared source of authority.

structural_cues: The focus has a dual possessive and dual verb, followed by a sustained series of dual nouns and predicates.
55:60 closes the first garden sequence with a mirrored good-for-good formulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated dual morphology, joined counterparts, and corresponding recompense; I infer that numerical pairing enacts fitted relation between recipients, gifts, and response. The alternative is ornamental dual symmetry with no distributive force.

changed_reading.before: Two classes are jointly asked a generic question about many gifts.
changed_reading.after: Each member of the addressed pair is confronted by matched provision and matched return: which fitted counterpart will either one refuse to recognize?

context_deltas.mechanism: Dense plant growth, ramifying branches, continuing provision, harvest taken at its source, and fixed growing good turn the garden catalog into a process. The non-dominant growth branch of رَبِّ then becomes productive: the Lord is encountered as cultivator and the favors as sustained becoming rather than finished inventory.

activation_trace.role: Interwoven, surging vegetation gives the garden an active growth mechanism.
Branching extension shows growth differentiating into many reachable forms.
Continuing provision makes the flowing springs a durable supply process.
Taking produce from its growing place connects nurture to accessible harvest.
Fixed, growing good closes the surah by naming endurance and increase together.
Nurture and growing up anchor the whole ecology in the focus title for the giver.
Favors become the ongoing outputs of cultivation rather than static objects.

structural_cues: 55:48-76 repeatedly alternates the refrain with branching, flowing, fruiting, harvesting, and verdant states.
The final blessing formula at 55:78 closes the same growth sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, branching, flow, harvest, and fixed increase; I supply the causal arrow that treats these as one cultivated ecology under lordly nurture. The live alternative is a static enumeration of rewards.

changed_reading.before: The favors are completed amenities displayed in a garden.
changed_reading.after: The favors are living processes of cultivation, flow, ripening, and renewal by which the Lord continually raises provision into reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places total disappearance beside a remaining divine face. That contrast activates the non-dominant ت ل و branches of remainder and a right that follows its holder: a received favor can leave an outstanding claim that survives the consumed object and follows its recipient into accountability.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after duration strips away the goods that could be mistaken for the whole favor.
What remains after loss supplies the temporal residue on which the claim model depends.
Face as self or essence locates permanence in the giver rather than in transient gifts.
A remainder following what preceded lets each favor leave something still due.
A liability or right following its holder makes the residue relational and answerable.
Declaring false becomes an attempt to cancel the surviving claim.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 juxtaposes universal disappearance with what remains before the refrain returns.
The refrain continues through judgment and reward, so receipt does not terminate its demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disappearance, remainder, enduring essence, and a right that follows its holder; I infer that benefit leaves an accountable residue after consumption. A live alternative is purely ontological contrast with no legal-temporal claim.

changed_reading.before: A favor is exhausted when its benefit has been consumed.
changed_reading.after: A favor leaves an outstanding claim of recognition that follows the recipient after the transient gift disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good action answered by good action, the recurring covenant branch of رَبّ, and a gift that seeks a counterpart strengthen the focus-only covenant model. Each refrain can be heard as a periodic summons to reciprocate acknowledged benefaction, while the generosity reading remains live and resists reducing gift to transaction.

activation_trace.role: An act answered with its recompense supplies explicit reciprocity.
The same good action on both sides gives reciprocity its ethical quality.
The covenant branch at the closing Lord-reference carries the binding relation to the surah's end.
A gift seeking a counterpart activates reciprocity while leaving its transactional force contestable.
The oath branch gives the recurring summons a pledged edge.
The focus Lord-reference anchors the pact in the exact relation being questioned.
Urging or obligation makes the refrain press for enacted acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 55:60 balances identical good-action forms around the recompense construction.
55:78 closes with the Lord-reference and honor after the last refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal action, covenant, oath, urging, and a gift-with-counterpart branch; I infer a covenantal response owed to benefaction. The materially live alternative is unconditioned generosity that does not create transactional debt.

changed_reading.before: The question requests verbal admission that gifts came from the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The question periodically calls the recipients to reciprocate benefaction through pledged recognition and fitting good action, without collapsing grace into payment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The plant branch is a form-distant homonym and must not replace the ordinary sense of favors. It remains anchored in the focus ء ل و inventory and is immediately activated by branching and fruit; downstream prose should present it only as a botanical material analogy in which a gift can be beautiful yet carry bitterness or testing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ءَالَآءِ at word 2 carries the supplied branch of a beautiful-looking, bitter-tasting shrub.

activation_trace.role: The named shrub supplies the surprising beauty-bitterness material tension inside the focus noun.
Immediate ramifying branches make the plant image locally visible after the focus.
Pleasant fruit supplies the expected sweetness against which concealed bitterness becomes diagnostic.

changed_reading.before: A favor is self-evidently pleasant and therefore easy to acknowledge.
changed_reading.after: Some favor may be recognized only by holding beauty and testing together rather than denying the gift when its taste is bitter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it links cosmic coating and patterned garden textiles to a cloth that lies by appearance. It remains anchored in the focus ك ذ ب branch and in exact packet images, but it must not imply that the promised garden or its textiles are deceptive; render it only as an analogy for denial enacted through a surface that misreports the underlying state.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ at word 4 carries a branch in which patterned or dyed cloth deceives by its condition.

activation_trace.role: A variegated cloth that lies by appearance supplies denial as performed surface rather than spoken proposition.
Oil or coating supplies a transformed cosmic surface whose appearance can dominate perception.
Precious patterned textiles reactivate the exact material domain of the focus false-cloth branch.
The same context root's pure-falsehood branch makes the textile-to-false-surface activation unusually explicit.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an inward belief or outward statement that contradicts truth.
changed_reading.after: Denial can also be a fashioned surface: a life-display that visually claims one relation to favor while its underlying conduct enacts another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk-failure branch is pastoral and lexically remote from the focus usage. It remains worth carrying because flowing and gushing provision directly activates the expectation of sustained supply; downstream prose should label it a hydrological-pastoral analogy, not a lexical gloss or a prediction that provision literally fails.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ at word 4 carries a branch for milk disappearing instead of continuing as expected.

activation_trace.role: Milk that fails expectation supplies a temporal model of denial as anticipated discontinuity.
Continuing provision gives the flowing springs the persistence that the failure image negates.
Water welling abundantly intensifies the promise of supply that does not dry up.
Abundant collected water anchors sustained supply in the focus Lord-reference.

changed_reading.before: Denying favor means rejecting that any supply was given.
changed_reading.after: Denying can take the temporal form of expecting the giver's supply to fail, treating present flow as unable to continue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The running animal branch is vivid and zoological, so it is too distant to state as the verb's meaning. It remains anchored in the focus ك ذ ب inventory and gains a coherent motion pattern from attempted penetration and punitive circling; downstream prose should mark it as an analogy for evasive denial that moves, stalls, looks back, and loops rather than facing the claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ at word 4 carries a branch for a wild animal running a stage and then stopping to look behind.

activation_trace.role: Run-then-stop motion supplies the embodied rhythm of attempted evasion and backward checking.
The repeated attempt to pass fully through supplies outward flight toward an imagined escape.
Circling between endpoints converts failed outward flight into a closed punitive circuit.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a fixed intellectual refusal.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be evasive motion: rushing past the claim, stalling to look back, and finally circling because no passage beyond accountability opens.

strongest_changes: Exact recurrence and the non-dominant following-voice branch recast 55:47 as an antiphonal recognition drill within a merciful pedagogy.
Measure, non-shortchanging, and reciprocal action recast takdhib as failing an entrusted charge, not only speaking falsehood.
Its position between feared standing and ramifying gardens makes 55:47 a hinge where accountability opens into cultivated refuge.
Garden duals and growth processes make lordly favor relational, paired, flowing, and continually cultivated rather than a static list.
Remainder, covenant, and following-right branches preserve a coexisting legal-temporal reading in which received favor leaves a durable claim.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's split mappings were unusually productive: ء ل و opened into oath, capacity, sequential voice, remainder, liability, and a bittersweet plant, while ر ب ب opened into nurture and growth. Context did not collapse these into one interpretation; it supplied distinct pedagogical, juridical, ecological, affective, perceptual, and kinetic mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The ت ل و activations may be deliberate sound-and-sequence resonances or only packet-authorized formal possibilities; they should remain visibly non-dominant.
The repeated dual pattern may enact distributive correspondence between two audiences and paired gifts, or may function primarily as grammatical and rhetorical symmetry.
The botanical, textile, milk-failure, and run-stop models are anchored but materially distant; their value is diagnostic surprise, not lexical replacement.
Covenantal reciprocity and unconditioned generosity remain in productive tension and should not be forced into a single transactional model.
